description: Rules that need a descriptor in hand: complete port batches, the observation delay rule, byte shapes and descriptor agreement.

cases.name: a complete port control
a port control at both analog limits
cases.reason: the limits are inclusive

cases.name: a port control one step past a bipolar limit
cases.reason: out of range is refused, never clamped

cases.name: a port control past a unit limit
cases.reason: out of range is refused, never clamped

cases.name: a port control with a missing button
cases.reason: every declared button must be present

cases.name: a port control with an extra button
cases.reason: no extra controls

cases.name: a port control with the buttons in another order
cases.reason: descriptor order is part of the contract

cases.name: a complete batch
a batch that omits a declared port
cases.reason: uncontrolled ports are configured neutral, not omitted

cases.name: a batch with the same port twice
cases.reason: reject duplicates and missing ports

cases.name: a batch naming an undeclared port
cases.reason: all ids must match exactly

cases.name: sensory input at its boundary with no declared delay
sensory input one boundary stale with no declared delay
cases.reason: missing or extra delay is a step failure, not an arbitrary latest frame

cases.name: sensory input for an undeclared view
cases.reason: the environment declares its views

cases.name: sensory input with the wrong frame length
cases.reason: artifact length equals rowStride x height

cases.name: sensory input honouring a two step pipeline delay
cases.reason: producedStep is max(0, boundary - observationDelaySteps)

cases.name: sensory input ignoring a two step pipeline delay
cases.reason: a fresher frame than the declared pipeline is also a failure

cases.name: bootstrap repeating boundary zero under a delay
cases.reason: max(0, 1 - 2) is 0: bootstrap may repeat O[0]

cases.name: a world observation
a world observation with a mismatched audio length
cases.reason: artifact length is sampleFrames x channels x 4

cases.name: a world observation with another inspection schema
cases.reason: inspection uses the descriptor's schema

cases.name: a step result that advances world time by one step duration
cases.reason: two steps of 50000000/3 ns

cases.name: a step result that advances world time by two step durations
cases.reason: an emulator cannot hide two framework steps behind one result

cases.name: a snapshot that agrees with its descriptor
a snapshot naming an agent outside the composition
cases.reason: descriptor and snapshot must agree

cases.name: a snapshot driving another agent's port
cases.reason: the coordinator assigns the port, and it is the assigned one

cases.name: a snapshot with telemetry roles in another order
cases.reason: rates are in profile-defined order

cases.name: a snapshot for another descriptor revision
cases.reason: descriptor/index mismatch is visible
